images.title: Adding and subtracting capacities in columns
images.purpose: Show that capacities are added and subtracted like weights: 4 l 600 ml + 3 l 700 ml = 8 l 300 ml with a carry of 1 l, and 6 l 200 ml − 2 l 900 ml = 3 l 300 ml with 1 l broken into 1,000 ml.
images.composition: Two column sums side by side, an addition with a carry on the left and a subtraction with a break on the right, and the link 1 l = 1,000 ml below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. LEFT SUM (addition). COLUMN HEADS at y 130: l (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2) at x 220 and ml (44 px, bold, amber-dark #E69F00) at x 470. ROW 1 at y 270: 4 at x 220 and 600 at x 470. ROW 2 at y 370: the sign + at x 110, then 3 at x 220 and 700 at x 470. RULE LINE 4 px dark #1F2937 at y 420 from x 40 to x 600. RESULT ROW at y 510: 8 at x 220 and 300 at x 470 (teal #0072B2). CARRY: a small circle 44 px across with a 3 px outline #CC79A7 and the digit 1 at (220, 215) above the l column. NOTE at (330, 620): 600 + 700 = 1,300 ml (36 px, dark #1F2937). All numbers 60 px, bold, dark #1F2937 unless stated. RIGHT SUM (subtraction). COLUMN HEADS at y 130: l (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2) at x 900 and ml (44 px, bold, amber-dark #E69F00) at x 1160. ROW 1 at y 270: the digit 6 crossed by a thin diagonal line at x 900 with 5 above it at y 215 (circled), and 200 crossed by a thin diagonal line at x 1160 with 1,200 above it at y 215 (circled). ROW 2 at y 370: the sign − (minus, U+2212) at x 790, then 2 at x 900 and 900 at x 1160. RULE LINE 4 px dark #1F2937 at y 420 from x 700 to x 1360. RESULT ROW at y 510: 3 at x 900 and 300 at x 1160 (teal #0072B2). NOTE at (1030, 620): 1,200 − 900 = 300 ml (36 px, dark #1F2937). All numbers 60 px, bold, dark #1F2937 unless stated. DIVIDER: a thin grey #6B7280 vertical line 3 px at x 728 from y 120 to y 700. FOOTER centred at x 728, y 740: the text 1 l = 1,000 ml (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Add and subtract capacities like weights: exchange 1,000 ml for 1 l, or break 1 l into 1,000 ml.
images.description: Two column sums: 4 l 600 ml plus 3 l 700 ml giving 8 l 300 ml, and 6 l 200 ml minus 2 l 900 ml giving 3 l 300 ml.
images.context: Concept image for Adding and Subtracting Capacities. It follows the idea of the l and ml columns in your maths book and shows the concept's own examples (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Do the ml column first in both sums. The slip to watch: taking the smaller number from the bigger in a column.

image_decisions.why: The carry and the break are shown in the same columns the student used for weights.
